lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters organized into three primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with clusters spaced at semi-regular intervals across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal carinae are visible; the uppermost ridge exhibits a sharp specular highlight along its dorsal edge with a corresponding sharp luminance drop-off into shadow on the ventral edge, following the longitudinal body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin exhibits a gradient transition from sparse, large high-luminance blobs at the base to a high-density population of small punctate spots towards the distal tip; presence of three Echeneidae individuals swimming ventrally to the shark's midline.
